scope: Native release check configuration enforcement; not deployed policy proof
behaviors: Consumer policy must declare configuration for every required check, including explicit empty objects where applicable
Matching passed checks and images cannot authorize missing, extra or changed provider/protocol/authentication configuration
Canonical object order is irrelevant; array order and exact JSON values remain significant
Actual CLI forwards consumer configuration and rejects changed provider mode
limits: Synthetic configuration and deployment fixtures; no operational target or provider policy selected
Producer observations are compared, not independently attested
Existing policies must add requiredCheckConfigurations and result.configuration; actual release pipeline deployment remains outstanding

review.independent: Approved JSON/CLI path; sparse-array direct API edge identified and fixed
